item.title: CISA issues mandatory directive following active wild exploitation of PHP2Shell zero day flaw CVE-2026-121102
item.description:
Federal cybersecurity authorities have updated Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog directives under Binding Operational Directive 22-01, ordering federal agencies to remediate an actively weaponized web application runtime flaw. Remote threat actors exploit multi-part form boundary parsing errors to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution across web servers.
The emergency directive addresses PHP core runtime vulnerability CVE-2026-121102 carrying a CVSS score of 9.8 and codenamed PHP2Shell. Unauthenticated remote adversaries transmit crafted HTTP POST requests containing malformed boundary parameters to trigger heap buffer overflows within internal string parsing subroutines. Threat intelligence feeds confirm active wild exploitation targeting self-hosted web applications, WordPress installations, and enterprise e-commerce portals. CISA established a mandatory December 9 compliance deadline for Federal Civilian Executive Branch agencies to deploy emergency runtime maintenance updates.
Subverting core web application runtimes introduces systemic risks across public web portals and e-commerce platforms. Because PHP powers millions of enterprise web applications and content management systems globally, an unauthenticated heap corruption RCE permits threat actors to hijack web server processes, exfiltrate database credentials, and establish persistent web shell access.
- Upgrade PHP core runtime installations immediately across web host fleets and container base images to patched maintenance builds. - Enforce Web Application Firewall WAF rules to inspect HTTP POST request body boundaries and drop malformed multipart form submissions. - Inspect web server error logs and execution stacks for unverified memory segmentation faults originating from PHP worker processes. - Restrict file system write permissions across web root directories, disabling direct script execution within uploaded content paths.
Enterprise web application defense requires immediate runtime security updates and rigid perimeter request inspection to ensure web hosting infrastructure remains insulated from unauthenticated remote code execution. #CodeDefence #PHP #PHP2Shell #CISA #KEV #RCE #WebSecurity #AppSec #PatchManagement #WordPress #CloudSecurity

item.title: SonicWall issues urgent patch for critical SonicOS SAML MFA bypass flaw CVE-2026-120050 exploited in wild
item.description:
Perimeter security advisories published today warn of accelerated threat activity targeting remote access firewall appliances. Remote unauthenticated threat actors exploit single sign-on logic errors to bypass multi-factor authentication controls and establish persistent network footholds.
The security bulletin covers SonicOS firmware vulnerability CVE-2026-120050 affecting SonicWall Gen6 and Gen7 firewall appliances. Threat actors holding secondary single sign-on authentication credentials send malformed SAML assertions to bypass enforced multi-factor authentication checks, gaining unauthenticated remote SSL VPN access to internal subnets. Threat telemetry indicates threat actors actively weaponize exposed management interfaces worldwide. Vendor updates mandate immediate deployment of firmware release builds 7.1.3-7020 and 6.5.4.15-116n.
Subverting perimeter firewall controllers destroys corporate remote access boundaries and internal subnet isolation. Because SonicWall firewalls manage corporate SSL VPN access and site-to-site IPsec tunnels, an unauthenticated SAML authentication bypass permits threat actors to hijack user sessions, inspect internal network transit traffic, and move laterally across production subnets.
- Upgrade SonicOS firmware installations immediately across Gen6 and Gen7 firewalls to maintenance builds 7.1.3-7020 or 6.5.4.15-116n. - Audit SAML identity provider configuration logs for anomalous single sign-on authentication assertions originating from unverified IP ranges. - Restrict public internet access to firewall management interfaces, placing administrative portals on isolated out-of-band VLANs. - Invalidate active remote access user session tokens and execute mandatory credential rotations across VPN user accounts.
Perimeter firewall controller defense demands immediate firmware patch application and rigid identity provider verification to ensure corporate remote access gateways remain insulated from authentication bypass exploits. #CodeDefence #SonicWall #SonicOS #MFA #SAML #AuthBypass #CISA #KEV #NetworkSecurity #AppSec #PatchManagement

item.title: Claude Code settings file secret leaks trigger automated cloud key harvesting campaigns
item.description:
Cloud security intelligence disclosures published today warn of widespread automated credential harvesting campaigns targeting developer repositories. Adversaries exploit insecure configuration storage defaults in developer command-line tools to extract plain-text API credentials and cloud access keys.
The security vulnerability affects developer workstations running early iterations of Anthropic's Claude Code command-line tool. Technical writeups confirm that local configuration settings files stored user access tokens and cloud API keys in unencrypted plain-text files within working directories. Automated GitHub scraping scripts scanning public code commits identified hundreds of exposed secrets, leading to unauthorized cloud infrastructure access and secondary supply-chain intrusion attempts. Anthropic released patched CLI tooling enforcing encrypted credential storage subroutines.
Exposing API authentication tokens and cloud infrastructure secrets compromises enterprise identity security and developer workstation integrity. When developer tools write plain-text credentials to local project subdirectories, accidental code repository commits allow threat actors to harvest secrets and launch automated cloud account takeover operations.
- Upgrade Claude Code CLI tools immediately to patched releases enforcing encrypted secret storage handlers. - Execute automated secret scanning across corporate Git repositories to identify exposed API tokens or credential strings. - Rotate all exposed developer API keys, cloud service credentials, and personal access tokens immediately. - Enforce strict pre-commit hooks and repository scanning rules to block plain-text secret uploads to version control servers.
Developer environment security demands strict credential store encryption and continuous code commit scanning to ensure software development workflows remain protected against automated secret exfiltration. #CodeDefence #ClaudeCode #Anthropic #DevSecOps #SecretScanning #APISecurity #CloudSecurity #IdentitySecurity #AppSec #SupplyChain
